title: Mixed A4
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Given n integers, print the length of the longest strictly
increasing subsequence.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n ≤ 200000; 0 ≤ a[i] < 100000.

**Input:** line 1: n; line 2: n values.
**Output:** one integer.

tests.name: sample
all equal
decreasing
full scale
tests.hint: Requires the O(n log n) patience method; O(n²) is 4·10^10 comparisons.
